title: Metric classification of Blaschke manifolds
exact_target: If a connected closed smooth Riemannian manifold of positive dimension has injectivity radius equal to diameter, must some positive scaling of its metric be isometric to a standard round sphere, real/complex/quaternionic projective space, or Cayley plane?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
